title: Installments Counted in an Income Annuities Commutation, by Contract Status
content:
Which installments are commuted when a beneficiary of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract takes the commuted value depends on the contract's status, as its record shows it.

**While the remaining installments are already continuing to the beneficiary** (status beneficiary continuing): the count is one installment for each payment date from the next payment date through the certain period end date, both included, all of them discounted. In addition, any certain installment that fell due after the date of death and on or before the approval of the death claim and still stands unissued is added undiscounted at the amount of the last installment issued to the annuitant.

**While the death claim is still pending** (status death claim pending): the count is that same number — one installment for each payment date from the next payment date through the certain period end date — plus one installment for each whole payment period elapsed since the date of death, all of them discounted.

**In any other status**, neither of these counts applies.

### Terms as the records show them

- *Next payment date* and *certain period end date*: as recorded on the contract.
- *Approval of the death claim*: the decision date of the death claim on file whose certified death certificate is shown as received.
- *Still stands unissued*: a certain payment date after the date of death and on or before that approval for which the activity history shows no issued installment; the number added is the payment dates in that span less those issued, never below zero.
- *The last installment issued to the annuitant*: the issued installment with the latest payment date whose payee is the annuitant.

### Cases (hypothetical monthly contract, payment day the 1st; death 10 March; claim approved 20 June; 41 payment dates from the next payment date through the certain period end date)

| Status | Activity history for 1 April, 1 May, 1 June | Discounted installments | Added undiscounted |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beneficiary continuing | All three issued to the beneficiary | 41 | None |
| Beneficiary continuing | Only 1 April issued | 41 | 2, at the last installment issued to the annuitant |
| Beneficiary continuing | None issued | 41 | 3, at the last installment issued to the annuitant |

*Pending claim (hypothetical).* Same death date, claim still pending on 25 April, next payment date 1 May with 44 payment dates from 1 May through the certain period end date: one whole month has elapsed since 10 March, so the count is 44 plus 1, that is 45, all discounted. A second whole payment period elapses on 10 May, two whole months after the death.
